title: Security deposit payments
requirement: Landlords may only charge a maximum of one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units, with an exception for certain small landlords who may charge up to two months' rent.
exemptions: Landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or limited liability company (LLC) where all members are natural persons
quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units

title: Security deposit interest
requirement: Landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
coverage_conditions: units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance
quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
